tested_workflows: LAB-COMP-MAP-001: Finding-to-control mapping across NIST SP 800-53, OWASP API 2023, and SOC 2
LAB-COMP-CAT-002: Catalog ingestion and schema validation (minimal, multi-control, rejection of malformed/oversized/duplicate)
LAB-COMP-EVAL-003: Evidence-backed compliance evaluation across 7 canonical states (absence of findings != compliant)
LAB-COMP-GATE-004: Compliance gate decision logic and exit code contracts (strict, enforced controls, exact threshold, fail-closed)
LAB-COMP-OSCAL-005: NIST OSCAL v1.1.0 Assessment Results export & official JSON Schema validation
LAB-COMP-DOSSIER-006: Compliance dossier generation & cryptographic HMAC tamper detection
LAB-COMP-MTTR-007: Deterministic MTTR and Remediation SLA calculations with invalid timestamp exclusions
LAB-COMP-ROBUST-008: Security boundaries, path traversal defense, and secret canary protection
limitations: Automated compliance evaluation reflects technical security assessment evidence and does not constitute statutory certification or organizational audit attestation.
Absence of findings does not automatically imply compliance; positive evidence or explicit applicability determination is required.
Historical MTTR calculations exclude records with invalid causal timestamps or missing event logs.

detectors.name: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
preconditions: Two distinct authenticated user identities (User A, User B)
detectors.ground_truth_method: Differential comparison between owner baseline response and non-owner cross-principal request. Verified only if non-owner receives identical protected object payload or designated sensitive marker.
limitations: Read-only by default; state-changing mutation tests require explicit --allow-state-changing flag.

detectors.name: Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA)
detectors.ground_truth_method: Lower-privilege identity executing administrative endpoint receives 200 OK and administrative capability rather than 401/403.
limitations: Requires identification of administrative endpoints.

detectors.name: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA / Mass Assignment)
detectors.ground_truth_method: Injected protected attribute modification is persisted or confirmed by state verification response.
limitations: Requires disposable test objects for mutation testing.

detectors.name: API Security & Schema Conformance
preconditions: OpenAPI / Swagger spec or target API base URL
detectors.ground_truth_method: Checks endpoint responses against schema specifications, payload validation, content-type enforcement.
limitations: GraphQL introspection requires GraphQL endpoint.

detectors.name: Authentication Mechanism Audit
detectors.ground_truth_method: Tests credential stuffing resilience, brute-force rate limits, JWT signature validation (none alg, weak secret).
limitations: Does not attempt destructive account lockouts without approval.

detectors.name: Authorization Matrix Matrix Verification
preconditions: Authorization policy YAML/JSON defining roles and permissions
detectors.ground_truth_method: Evaluates full cartesian product of roles x endpoints x methods against declared policy.
limitations: Requires policy configuration file.

detectors.name: Web Application Vulnerabilities (XSS, SQLi, SSRF, CORS)
preconditions: Web endpoints with query or body parameters
detectors.ground_truth_method: Active canary reflection and AST verification for XSS; differential timing/error analysis for SQLi; loopback SSRF guards.
limitations: OAST out-of-band verification requires reachable callback server.

detectors.name: Session Security & Cookie Flags
detectors.ground_truth_method: Validates Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite attributes, entropy of session IDs, token revocation on logout.
limitations: None.

detectors.name: Cloud Metadata & SSRF Exposure
preconditions: Reachable endpoints accepting URLs or webhook inputs
detectors.ground_truth_method: Tests reachability of AWS (169.254.169.254), GCP, Azure, and Kubernetes service account tokens.
limitations: Fails closed on unapproved IP ranges.

detectors.name: Business Logic & Race Condition Auditing
preconditions: Multi-step transaction or coupon/discount redemption endpoint
detectors.ground_truth_method: Concurrent burst requests (single-packet attack emulation) to test idempotency and double-spend.
limitations: Requires disposable mock or sandbox environment.

detectors.name: API Specification Reconciliation & Shadow Endpoint Discovery
detectors.ground_truth_method: Compares crawled routes and prober hits against documented spec routes; identifies undocumented and zombie APIs.
limitations: Requires OpenAPI spec file.

detectors.name: Active Shadow & Internal Route Prober
preconditions: Dictionary of internal and management paths
detectors.ground_truth_method: Sends targeted probes to common undocumented paths (/admin, /metrics, /debug/pprof, /actuator) and verifies status code.
limitations: Subject to rate limits.

detectors.name: Declarative Multi-Tenant Cross-Tenant Prober
preconditions: Declarative target profile containing at least 2 tenants with tokens and resource IDs
detectors.ground_truth_method: Tenant A credentials probe Tenant B resources; flags finding if Tenant B data is returned.
limitations: Requires profile YAML with tenant configurations.

detectors.name: High-Entropy Secret & Key Scanner
preconditions: Target client JavaScript bundles, APK bytecode, or API responses
detectors.ground_truth_method: Shannon entropy calculation and pattern matching for AWS keys, GitHub tokens, Stripe secrets, private keys.
limitations: None.

detectors.name: Multi-Hop Attack Path Correlation & Risk Scoring
detectors.ground_truth_method: Constructs directed attack graph chaining perimeter exposure to lateral movement to privilege escalation.
limitations: Requires at least one finding.

detectors.name: Out-of-Band Application Security Testing (OAST)
preconditions: Reachable endpoints accepting URLs or callback destinations
detectors.ground_truth_method: Generates cryptographically unpredictable correlation tokens, monitors loopback simulator callbacks, verifies correlation and duplicate suppression.
limitations: In offline/isolated environments, uses local in-process simulator.

detectors.name: Business Logic Workflow Integrity & Step Circumvention
detectors.ground_truth_method: Executes terminal or later workflow stages directly omitting mandatory predecessor prerequisites; verifies bypass via independent read-back state.
limitations: Requires defined workflow policy or declarative steps.

unsupported_capabilities.name: Dynamic Android Instrumentation (Frida / Xposed)
unsupported_capabilities.reason: FELIX APK assessment is strictly static (DEX/manifest decompilation). Dynamic mobile runtime instrumentation is out of scope.

unsupported_capabilities.name: Zero-Configuration Single-User BOLA Detection
unsupported_capabilities.reason: Generic unauthenticated web scanning cannot reliably establish BOLA without two distinct authenticated identities and object ownership mappings. Dual-identity baseline comparison is strictly required.

unsupported_capabilities.name: Blind Out-of-Band Callback Server Hosting (Self-Contained)
unsupported_capabilities.reason: OAST probes require external network infrastructure to receive out-of-band callbacks; offline / loopback lab cannot verify external callbacks without mock OAST.
